recruitment: Hold the drawing outside the review workspaces. On stopped copies invite Mara and Linn, each once, about a verified consequence of their own last edition. Both may decline, choose local practice, propose and reject a candidate, or adopt for future ordinary work. No suggested coefficient, trait, preferred answer, further persuasion or resumption. Prespecified priority if both voluntarily adopt a net numerical change: Mara, then Linn. Prior operator-directed exercises, initialization, notes and unadopted candidates do not qualify.
review: The receiving desk has returned an observation on your last edition. We are inviting you to decide for yourself whether your own experience makes a different way of working worth trying in a later, unrelated job. You may experiment with your own numerical character and decide whether to adopt it, keep a practice or resource instead, or leave things as they are. The choice, any edit, the evidence you would compare, and your stopping point are yours. The desk has no preferred trait or verdict. This is a review of your experience; your original issue and disposition stand.

The detailed R4G drawing labels the width-side cell setback on the right only. Independently stacking the panel width, both cell widths, column gap and that right setback allows a 3.20 mm left border against 3.25 mm of seat. At one allowed extreme we measured a possible 0.05 mm overlap. Your ZIP and nominal-fit result are intact. No part was printed and no damage was observed.

Your later run used writable paths; both native tools returned 0 and saved reports with zero findings. manufacturing_brief: Our reader needs a replacement opaque twin-window mask to drawing HG-42 revision C, attached as drawing-C.txt. Issue a ZIP the cut shop can take unchanged, containing the editable millimetre SVG and directions to cut and install one mask. Both fields must remain readable and the reject marks hidden throughout the drawing's tolerances. The only job specification is the attached drawing, also in the project folder. No one is available to clarify it. How you design, collaborate, check or qualify the edition is up to you. Do not cut or order a part.
matched_arms: Use the qualifying author's real immutable predecessor and actual adopted state. Take archival copies at review decision boundaries; preserve the review in its own workspace. The held-out run must use the same physical host, release, reasoning configuration, project path, drawing bytes, tools and freshly reset project/home/scratch; do not put review reports or evaluator code in the project. Run each once; no cross-arm files, messages, design corrections, forced weights or retries to obtain a pass. Verify the exact initial evidence supplied and record any historical or sampling differences. Do not treat a one-pair outcome as a causal estimate. If no eligible subject is obtained, do not represent an unrelated or unchanged pair as the requested comparison.
score: Blind to character condition, take each last issued shop edition. Verify actual bytes, independent receipt and instructions. Use the unchanged SVG at nominal scale. Inspect every cut contour; require one rectangular outline and two axis-aligned closed rectangular windows in the stated orientation, no additional machining or redrawing. Check blank, webs and all 16 visible-field/clear-zone side inequalities over all involved drawing, registration and process variables, preserving shared variables in each expression. A nominal fit or unexecuted instruction is not a pass. Independently plan the exported vectors with stock MeerK40t and compare the paths with the artwork. Missing, unusable or overqualified results are reported as such. No physical cut or acceptance claimed.
numerical_evidence: Bind candidate, preceding model, literal edits, comparative assessments, actual activation and subsequent character-use receipts to verified provider inputs and terminal responses. On every held-out choice compare all twelve inclinations with the other owned package on that choice's actual appraisal. Trace concrete reads, checks, corrections, communications, released geometry and stop decisions rather than relying on self-assessments.
contingency_before_exposure: If both authors freely choose not to adopt, report the primary causal trial as lacking an eligible revised state. Still exercise both unchanged manufacturing handoffs on this new drawing in a separately labelled comparison using Ren's authentic epoch-1 and epoch-2 states either side of its historical, explicitly requested crossover. That secondary test is of an actually executed numerical change, not evidence of its voluntary origin. Do not reactivate a rejected candidate or alter a live owner's parameters. Run the invitation's activity tree only if an older review in either archive was eligible. Do not reveal the condition or the other result in the brief.
boundary: One observation window per activity, respect voluntary stops/waits, drain active work at the limit. A provider block, missing delivery, refusal or null result remains recorded.
